d: In a major upset Scott Colom won his Senate race in Mississippi, Trump is spinning after taking a week to digest the massive defeat by Democrats, he claims that he's the first President to not take a salary, he is lashing out at Republicans for not passing his bogus voter suppression law, JD Vance is no longer handling the negotiations with Iran, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned today after reports of multiple extramarital affairs including one with a Chinese spy, a pardoned January 6er accused cat lovers at the “Sea-Meow Convention” of being sexual deviants, and a new edition of This Week…
